verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an MCP directory, hosting, and gateway platform with a REST API, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents batch or bulk endpoints, or multi-select actions across many servers, connectors, or instances. Related features such as per-tool toggles, directory synchronization, and schedule/webhook automation are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
